land.text: the German area north of the Memel River, East Prussia's Memelland, detached by the Treaty of Versailles

predecessors.note: The weimar-republic dossier records the loss as 'memel-territory' in January 1920 (Versailles in force 10 January 1920); the Klaipėda Region page's infobox misprints the date as 10 January 1919 and its text says 'in 1920'.

land.text: the Klaipėda Region, annexed by Lithuania in January 1923 and made 'an autonomous region under unconditional sovereignty of Lithuania' by the May 1924 convention

successors.note: Cliopatria's Kingdom of Lithuania row adds the region in 1924 (shape 62,642 km2 against 60,288 km2 in 1920-1923). From 1924 the region is Lithuanian and drawn with Lithuania, even while it kept its autonomy; Germany took it back in March 1939 (nazi-germany gain, counterpart kingdom-of-lithuania).

rulers.title: French High Commissioner
rulers.note: 1 May 1921 - 19 February 1923; the Klaipėda Revolt page spells the name 'Pestiné' in one passage.

correction.text: 'the German area north of the Memel River' given 'the status of Territoire de Memel' (infobox area 2,657 km2; the Klaipėda Revolt page gives 2,848 km2 including 412 km2 of the Curonian Lagoon); a 30 km radius around Memel (Klaipėda) is the closest name the gazetteer has

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, Cliopatria has no shape for the Memel Territory in 1920-1923: its German Empire/Weimar shapes may still contain it and its Kingdom of Lithuania shape adds the region only in 1924. Infobox area 2,657 km2 against a 30 km circle of about 2,800 km2 (ratio 1.05, fine); the revolt page's 2,848 km2 includes the lagoon. The real shape is a north-south strip on the Baltic coast, north of the Neman; the circle spills into Lithuania proper (Palanga, Gargždai) on the north and east and misses the south-western strip, so a gazetteer region 'Memelland' should replace it.

region.text: 'the German area north of the Memel River' given 'the status of Territoire de Memel' (infobox area 2,657 km2; the Klaipėda Revolt page gives 2,848 km2 including 412 km2 of the Curonian Lagoon); a 30 km radius around Memel (Klaipėda) is the closest name the gazetteer has

ledger.note: 15 February 1920: France takes over the Memel Territory. 'the French took over the temporary military administration of the region on 15 February 1920'; 'the German area north of the Memel River was given the status of Territoire de Memel' by the Treaty of Versailles (the territory's infobox: 'Special territory under League of Nations protection').

region.text: the Memel Territory under French military and then civil administration

ledger.note: 15 February 1920: French troops and High Commissioner Dominique Odry administer the territory for the Allied powers. 'the French took over the temporary military administration of the region on 15 February 1920'; Odry served 15 February 1920 - 1 May 1921, Petisné 1 May 1921 - 19 February 1923.

region.text: the Klaipėda Region, where Lithuanian volunteers fought the French garrison

ledger.note: 10 January 1923: the Klaipėda Revolt begins. 'The revolt started on January 10, 1923'; 'fighting over Klaipėda broke out on January 15' against a garrison of '250 French soldiers, 350 German policemen, and 300 civilian volunteers'. The Klaipėda Region page says 'On 9 January 1923 ... Lithuania occupied the territory'.

19 January 1923: Lithuania annexes the region. 'On 19 January, the territory was annexed by Lithuania' (infobox 'Annexed by Lithuania: 19 January 1923'); the Lithuanian parliament accepted the declaration on 24 January (Klaipėda Revolt page).

January 1923: French rule ends in practice. The garrison was beaten in the fighting of 15 January; the French High Commissioner Petisné's term is given as ending 19 February 1923, after the Conference of Ambassadors 'transferred the region to Lithuania under several conditions' on 17 February (Klaipėda Revolt page).

region.text: the Klaipėda Region, annexed by Lithuania

ledger.note: 19 January 1923: the Memel Territory passes to Lithuania. 'On 19 January, the territory was annexed by Lithuania'; 'the fait accompli was eventually confirmed by the Conference of Ambassadors in 1924'; 'On 8 May 1924, a further Convention on the Klaipėda region confirmed the annexation.' Cliopatria draws the region in Lithuania from 1924.

January 1923: the Memel Territory ceases to be a separate territory and is incorporated into Lithuania as an autonomous district. The Klaipėda Revolt page: the declaration asked for 'the region to be incorporated as an autonomous district into Lithuania'; on 17 February 1923 the Conference of Ambassadors 'transferred the region to Lithuania under several conditions'; the May 1924 convention made it 'an autonomous region under unconditional sovereignty of Lithuania'.

zones.text: 'the German area north of the Memel River' given 'the status of Territoire de Memel' (infobox area 2,657 km2; the Klaipėda Revolt page gives 2,848 km2 including 412 km2 of the Curonian Lagoon); a 30 km radius around Memel (Klaipėda) is the closest name the gazetteer has

wars.outcome: Lithuanian volunteers overthrow the French administration in January 1923 and the region is incorporated into Lithuania (annexed 19 January, accepted by the Seimas 24 January, transferred by the Conference of Ambassadors 17 February 1923, convention of May 1924).
wars.note: The revolt is dated 10-15 January 1923 on the revolt page and 9 January on the Klaipėda Region page, whose infobox gives 'Klaipėda Revolt: 10–15 January 1923'.

certainty.note: The frontier is the Versailles line 'north of the Memel River' with Germany, and the Lithuanian frontier of the former German district; the 30 km circle is only an approximation of it.

notes: Scope decision: the Klaipėda Region page covers 1920-1939 in one article, but from the January 1923 annexation (confirmed in 1924) the land is Lithuanian and Cliopatria draws it in the Kingdom of Lithuania from 1924; one dossier for the League-protected stage 1920-1923 avoids drawing the same land twice. The autonomy 1924-1939 and the German annexation of 22/23 March 1939 ('In the early hours of 23 March 1939 ... signed the Treaty of the Cession of the Memel Territory to Germany') belong to the kingdom-of-lithuania and nazi-germany dossiers; the 1945 return (the Soviets incorporated it into the Lithuanian SSR) belongs to lithuanian-soviet-socialist-republic. The pages do not give a day for the Convention of May 1924 beyond 8 May on the Klaipėda Region page. Cliopatria's Lithuania gains the region in 1924, a year after the de facto annexation; this dossier covers 1923. Gazetteer name wanted: region 'Memelland' (Klaipėda Region) for the strip north of the Neman.
